1.name: Create library account
1.user-story: As a library customer I want to create an account with my name, email address and password So I can list and borrow books from the online library

2.name: Don't return library account password
2.user-story: As a library customer I want my password to not be returned from the API So my account is more secure

3.name: Email validation on sign up
3.user-story: As a library customer I want to receive an error if the email address I sign up with is not valid So I can receive emails

4.name: Password length validation on sign up
4.user-story: As a library customer I want to receive an error if the password I sign up with is less than 8 characters long So my account is secure

5.name: Add book listings for lending
5.user-story: As a book lender I want to be able to create a book listing on my account with a title, author, genre and ISBN number So people can loan out my books

6.name: Title and author should be mandatory
6.user-story: As a library customer I want all book listings to have at least a title and an author So I know what I'm looking at.

7.name: Display books for lending
7.user-story: As a library customer I want to see a list of all books So I can find books to borrow.

8.name: Search for books by fields
8.user-story: As a library customer I want to be able to search for books with a specific title, author, genre or ISBN So I can find books I am interested in.

9.name: Display book details
9.user-story: As a library customer I want to be able to see the details of a book So I can make a decision about whether I want to borrow it.

10.name: Borrow a book
10.user-story: As a library customer I want to be able to borrow a book So I can read it and return it later.

function.output-action: update book status to borrowed and record borrower details and due date

11.name: Return a borrowed book
11.user-story: As a library customer I want to be able to return a book So I can complete the borrowing cycle and make the book available to others.

function.output-action: update book status to available and clear borrower details

12.name: Purchase a book
12.user-story: As a library customer I want to be able to purchase a book So I can own a copy of it.

function.output-action: process payment and update book status to sold

13.name: List a book for sale
13.user-story: As a bookshop or library I want to list books for sale So I can sell them to other bookshops or libraries.

function.input-action: create sale listing with price and condition
function.output-action: display book in marketplace with listed price and condition

14.name: Review and rate a book
14.user-story: As a library customer I want to leave a review and rating for a book So others can benefit from my experience.

function.output-action: store and display the review and rating with the book details

15.name: Web and mobile platform compatibility
15.user-story: As a user I want to access the library or bookshop app on both web and mobile platforms So I can use the service wherever I am.

compatibility.responsive-design: The app must be responsive and compatible with a wide range of devices and screen sizes.
compatibility.mobile-app: Native mobile applications must be available for iOS and Android.

16.name: Secure payment processing
16.user-story: As a user I want my payment information to be securely processed So I can safely purchase or borrow books.

security.payment-gateway: Utilize a secure and reliable payment gateway with PCI DSS compliance.
security.data-encryption: All sensitive data, including payment information, must be encrypted both in transit and at rest.

17.name: User profile management
17.user-story: As a user I want to manage my personal profile and update my information So I can keep my account up-to-date.

18.name: Notifications and reminders
18.user-story: As a user I want to receive notifications and reminders about borrowed books' due dates So I can return them on time.

function.input-action: schedule notifications based on borrowing due dates
function.output-action: send timely reminders to users via email or app notifications

19.name: Scan new books into the database
19.user-story: As a library owner I want to scan new books into the database So I can add them to the library.

function.input-action: scan new books into the database
function.output-action: add new books to the database

20.name: Remove books from the database
20.user-story: As a library owner I want to remove books from the database So I can remove them from the library.
